records.title: Stage 3B London 30m interaction event characterization
records.hypothesis: When the 30-minute NY opening range establishes acceptance through a London-session high or low, subsequent directional continuation in the direction of the accepted level is stronger than after a London-level sweep/rejection.
records.description: DEVELOPMENT-only event study separating retrospective first-trade-through, causal OR-close confirmation, and unchanged later PRINT ORB anchors.
records.notes: Stage 3B event analysis is complete on DEVELOPMENT. The experiment remains running because representative human review is pending. The hypothesis is a candidate only and is not validated or a strategy rule.
known_limitations: Eventual CLOSE_THROUGH/SWEEP conditioning at first trade-through is retrospective.
One-minute OHLC bars do not expose intrabar event ordering.
The first later validated PRINT is selected deterministically when both directions occur.
Sparse opposite-direction and no-ORB groups are labelled INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE.
warnings: No Validation or OOS_BURNED data was accessed.
No new entry, strategy, P&L, stop, target, or optimization was produced.
future_hypotheses: HYP-LONDON-ACCEPTANCE-01 may advance only after human review and a separately authorized validation protocol.

records.title: Stage 3C combined-state hypothesis test
records.hypothesis: 20-minute PRINT ORB continuation is stronger when the current OR is relatively wide versus recent history, but the OR is not in the highest-efficiency state.
records.description: Final DEVELOPMENT-only ORB round combining fixed causal OR-width bands with the unchanged 20-minute OR-efficiency quintiles.
records.notes: Stage 3C final ORB round completed on DEVELOPMENT. Classification: POTENTIALLY_INFORMATIVE. Disposition: PARKED_AS_RESEARCH_CANDIDATE. The hypothesis is not validated and no strategy rule or performance simulation was produced.
